title: The Runaway Ore Cart
story: Deep in the Moonquartz Mine, Skarnvault the Rail Gnawer chewed through the brake rope of a cart carrying three lantern-children, and it began rolling down the long straight tunnel at 9 feet per second. By the time Mr 6 skidded onto the rails, the cart already had a 150-foot head start. Mr 6 can sprint at 14 feet per second — and he has exactly one chance to time it right.
question: How many feet does Mr 6 run before he catches the cart?
solution: Mr 6 gains 14 - 9 = 5 feet on the cart every second.
praise: Comparing the two speeds was the key move — the last step was turning those 30 seconds back into the distance Mr 6 actually ran.
hint: Work out how much of the 150-foot gap Mr 6 closes in a single second, then find the time — but remember the question asks for feet.
victory: At 420 feet Mr 6 caught the tailgate, jammed his sword under the wheel, and the cart squealed to a stop one inch from the ledge. Skarnvault took one look at the arithmetic chalked on the rails and gnawed his way politely into retirement.
imagePrompt: A caped numeral-six knight sprinting along mine rails in a glowing quartz tunnel after a runaway ore cart full of wide-eyed lantern-carrying children, with a long ratlike rail-gnawing creature peeking from a side shaft.
